name: Massachusetts Independent Comics Expo
blurb: New England's premiere free-entry expo for independent comics and graphic novels, with hundreds of small-press artists, panels and workshops.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'the massachusetts independent comics expo When December 5 - 6, 2026 ... where Fuller Building at Boston University'; Attending page confirms 'Saturday, December 5, 2026 ... Sunday, December 6, 2026' at '808 Commonwealth Avenue, Boston, MA'.

notes: MICE has no 'All Guests' page; it occasionally names a single 'Special Guest' via blog posts. The only such post found ('Special Guest Update', dated Dec 4, 2025, naming Scott McCloud and a cancelled Raina Telgemeier) is about the already-finished Dec 2025 edition, not Dec 2026 - the 'Special Guest' blog category itself currently shows 'Posts Coming Soon', so guests is 'none-yet' for the 2026 show rather than reusing last year's names. Cover uses the image explicitly filed as 'MICE2026 Landing Cover.jpg'.
